sign_off.notes: I did not clear every area. I filed three reports and the developer replied "could not reproduce" to each, so none is confirmed. (1) Search in AndroidQA/Amaze: "readme" returned no results and "txt" omitted the readme.txt files in Alpha and Beta. (2) New Folder and Rename: a name that already exists ("Alpha", "notes.txt") shows no error and leaves OK/CREATE enabled. (3) Encrypt dialog: "Password doesn't match" stays on screen after both fields hold "abc". Working as expected: creating a folder, copying a file into a folder, moving a file into a folder, renaming a file, and rejecting "a/b.jpg" as an invalid name. Not tested: creating a new file, rotating the screen, copying or moving into a folder that already holds a same-named file, and copying a folder.
